Desires never truly end, even when fulfilled.

The wish to be acknowledged, the urge to do well... a young girl's desires are no different.

Having yet to learn how to untangle her wants, she first soothes the hunger right in front of her.

Believing, like a naive little rabbit, that a full belly will calm the heart as well, that a single carrot can make the world feel all right.

Still, if this can make her even a little happier, then so be it.

arcana_name: A White Moon Shines With the Sun's Warmth
episode:
"O heaven-sent genius, the unparalleled maid!"
Of your talents, did the world serenade.

Yet, in times of darkness, it was to your heart that they prayed,
for a sword may shatter, but a resolute heart can never be unmade.

Many abandon all in pursuit of the blade,
but by that path, you are not swayed.

To the meek and the powerless, alone and afraid,
it is your hand that reaches down to offer them aid.

Even when you felt lost and betrayed,
your heart never wavered, never strayed.

And as long as the laughter of children does not fade,
the warmth of the White Moon remains ever-present in the shade.

episode:
Master of a vast trading empire, darling of high society.
And yet, she is never satisfied.

The Morrel name reaches even the most secluded mountain villages, and its ships voyage forth in search of shores where none have yet set foot.

How much more must she earn before she is satisfied?
To such whispers, Cristelle responds only with a scornful smile.

"Money, the Morrel Ocean Traders... They are merely means to an end. My true purpose lies elsewhere."

What drives her is an eternal bondage, a shackle she cannot escape.
And the desire she has harbored for so long can be fulfilled not with money, but only with blood.

"This is training. Resistance training against... poison!"

Just as steel must be forged a thousand times to become a blade, sweetness can only be conquered one bite at a time.
Today, the warrior of Raven Wall marches once more toward the sweetest battlefield of all.

"Haaah... I'm finally done!

Today, as always, she yearns for the small taste of freedom found in just one drink.

Her heart trembles with excitement and fear alike... and yet, she embraces it willingly.

That is the first truth of the Celestial Arts that Fei came to realize.

A pavilion pierces the skies, rising higher than the clouds.
A solitary figure stands tall like an orchid blooming on a cliff.

"Tonight as well... the moon is bright."

The night wind gently brushes her hand, cautiously outstretched as if hesitant to touch the unkind moon.

Someone who examines every last clue, or someone who can find the culprit without any clues at all?

"The culprit is… you!"

…Of course, she has her reasons.
Her investigator’s intuition tells her so, after all.

Once again, Gwen pursues her investigation with more confidence than anyone, in her own unmistakable style.

A faint curve forms at the corners of the girl's lips as she murmurs in regret.

In truth, she knows that too much water kills a flower.
In truth, she resents the self-serving expectation that it would be well cared for.

Before long, the flower's owner will return and shed tears.
Yet, believing it was done in kindness, they will not even be able to grow angry.

That is exactly what Lydia wanted.

With the children's boisterous laughter, sand and dust rise across the playground.
The adults watch the ferocious dragon's attack with quiet smiles, because they know that dragon will not harm the children.

A young dragon who loves humans lives alongside them.

Searching for branches of fate she failed to see, and seeking the end of the vast spool of threads.

Wishing that great fortune will come to her once more.

Was I a butterfly in a dream?

Or was I, a butterfly, dreaming that I lived a human life?



Seira knew the answer.

In truth, dreams are the other side of reality.

Perhaps cats were born to make people smile.
Even their cries as they plead for food are considered lovable by the masses.
Seeing people smile at cats, Smile imitated cats.

But soon, she realized the issue with her approach.

People smile when they look at cats, but that does not mean cats smile when they look at people.
Like cats, Smile could make others smile, but no smile had ever graced her lips.

The morning of a first-rate Hunter begins with a dull stack of wanted posters.
From Raiders who looted merchant caravans to ferocious giant slimes...

To ordinary people, they may be terrifying creatures, but to a first-rate Hunter, they're nothing more than prey that will let her skills shine.

"Now then, which one should I pick this time?"

episode:
The blue roses of Candle Square always bloom in the same place.
The result of principles and planning, thorough preparation and perfect follow-through.
Her countless contingency plans stand ready, no matter what situation arises.

Even so, when she finds herself greeting a visitor she did not anticipate, a fleeting hint of bewilderment sometimes crosses her noble face.
But in no time at all, she will settle into a composed expression, curl her lips into a gentle smile, and extend a welcome.

"If you ever need the help of a Candle Square maid, please let me know."

Her fists raised against injustice are her pride.
The flames burning within her cold eyes are a beacon for the weak.

Roberta's world is simple and clear.
There are those who must be protected, and threats that must be eliminated.

Of course, she knows reality is not so simple.
But she also knows there is no method more certain than her fists.

"Whew... Well then, who's next?"

Icy eyes gaze upon the bare face of reality.

Purity is cleanliness.
Calamity seeps into impure times and spaces, so the swordswoman's hand cannot leave her sword hilt.

"Allow me to handle the rest, Ms. Roberta."

There are no stray thoughts.
She simply carries out the work delegated to her, in the way she is able.

A hawk walks proudly, layered in dignity and elegance.

But... why is it, I wonder?

You, who have no sense of dignity and greet everyone with a simple smile...
Why do you seem to shine just a little more than I do?

The moment the door opens, a group of little ears comes pouring out.

Seven lovely younger siblings welcome the return of their eldest sister.

Forgetting the hardships of the day, she gathers them into the warmest embrace in the world, feeling happier than anyone else in this moment.

episode:
Today, she aims for prey even farther away than yesterday.
After confirming her line of sight is clear and steady, she lets out a quiet breath.

"...Set aside the stray thoughts, Clarissa."

She focuses, exhales, and holds still.
The trigger is pulled so slowly and deeply that it is almost imperceptible.

A single gunshot echoes through the forest.

No matter how much she struggles and pulls, the threads binding her flesh remain as they were from the beginning.

Now a puppet that neither cries nor trembles, she can only accept her inevitable fate.

A soul hardened within stagnant time calmly reflects on her hatred for the one who captured her.
This passion for revenge that will not fade, even through eternity.

Today he came to wake her again, and today he was caught again.
Only five minutes remain until morning training.
No matter how much the small wings flutter, his companion does not budge.

"Mmm... you came to sleep with me? Okaaay..."

The phoenix wants to protest.
He wants to shout that he only came to wake the girl up. It was she who hugged him and fell asleep on her own.

But the only person capable of understanding the phoenix still has no intention of leaving the land of dreams.

With one small bag and a little travel money, she quietly leaves her home on a morning when everyone is still asleep.

She knows better than anyone that the passion burning in her chest cannot be cooled.

"I promise I'll come back once I become a great Savior."

Even now, Asherah still remembers the warm and bright sunlight that shone at that very moment as if blessing her pledge.

episode:
If one reins in ambition and takes hold of the bridle, they may reach beyond the very edge of the world.
What must be grasped in that hand is the courage to surpass the unknown.

A gentle hand that enforces order.
Within it, even justice as cold and sharp as a blade may come to carry compassion.

She pursues gold, yet at its end lies a gentle warmth, for what she truly yearns for is not a dull yellow lump, but compassionate love.
That lofty ideal shall someday shine with glory befitting her noble blood.

Oh, wind that runs bearing expectations.
Even if at times you must push through thorn-covered paths, may happiness at least be delivered to the places you reach.

Oh, young sage who walks in harmony with nature, whose innocent soul shall not be tainted by the stains of the mundane world.
The green shade of the forest has fallen, so now you need only walk your path.

A gaze aimed beyond the sights may call forth inevitability.
However, young marksman, do not disregard the hand that reaches toward you from your blind spot.

Strength is meaningful only when it is used to protect.
True, the unyielding spirit that drives you to roam the wilds is admirable.
Yet, without someone to stand beside you, you will fade away in loneliness.

Wounds pricked by the thorns that grew upon her own body become scars that do not easily heal.
For the girl whom no one could embrace or draw near, may the light that suddenly approached become a guide within the darkness.

arcana_name: Grand Master of the Wild Roses
episode:
A tree with deep roots, a rock firmly set in place.
Though she laments that she has no brilliance to boast of, her warmly burning radiance is clear to all but her.
Even if you stand isolated beyond a curtain of ice and snow, your blazing longing will someday awaken you, for a hero does not turn away from the beating of their heart.

The more one learns and practices, the greater one's awareness of their own ignorance grows.
Though bent and cast down, that which is never released to the very end is the symbol of existence that life itself bears.

Who built the steadfast fortress rising high into the sky?
Behind its unshakable and majestic bearing, someone's ceaselessly shed sweat continues to fall and seep into the ground, unnoticed.

Oh, moon oracle who has succeeded the eyes of predestination.
With those eyes, behold the future that endlessly intertwines and stretches forth, and retrieve the moon reflected upon the water's surface.

One who tends the candle, swearing to devote herself to the Journey of salvation.
Even if the entwining blue thorns steal away warmth, the light she kindles with her devotion shall illuminate everyone's night.

The willow tree is supple, yet not easily broken, and when woven together, its branches do not snap with ease.
Thus, a tender heart is steadfast, and a pair that leans on one another is strong.

Master and disciple walk within the mist.
Cool reason seeks to grasp the thread of the case.
A burning heart seeks to lift the veil of delusion.

A sneer hidden behind a brightly smiling mask is a secret silhouette shown to no one.
The true heart concealed behind the curtain reaches toward an unfathomable power.
At the end of the forbidden path, will one be met by friend or by foe?

Even the most knightly of knights harbors a wild beast within.
If guarded and trained, it shall grant valor and wisdom, but if hesitated over and shunned, it shall bestow ruin.

A pair of blades tempered by a vow of reclamation.
They would spread their wings, flaunting a spirit like raging waves.
Yet the hunt of a raptor hinges on waiting for the right moment to strike.

Like a single streak of light racing toward the brightest star in the night sky.
If even the pitch black darkness of night had a color, that color would resemble the girl.
